label_policy.LOCAL_QA: 必须查阅已保存/上传的文件或当前上下文之外的历史、记忆。
label_policy.DOWNLOAD: 明确获取文件或克隆仓库；主要交付是本地副本。
label_policy.BRAINSTORM: 提出新的候选机制、假设或创新方案及验证思路；未要求执行。
label_policy.EXPERIMENT: 明确编写/修改代码或执行一次已指定实验；未授权完整自主研究循环。
label_policy.AUTO_RESEARCH: 明确授权围绕目标自主调研、实现、实测，并按实验反馈迭代。

selection.method: Filter official intents; exclude listed semantically unmappable IDs before runs; SHA256-sort source IDs; take 16 per mapped project class; alternating zh-CN/en-US; first 4 dev, next 12 test; no translated ID appears twice. Authored scenarios are assigned to distinct groups/splits; they may still share wording and task patterns.

exclusions.16146: No topic or context: latest updates could refer to a task status.
exclusions.6682: Fragment with unclear entity; Chinese translation omits a topic.
exclusions.3101: Radio/media playback is outside this workbench taxonomy.
exclusions.1084: user friendly has no news request or identifiable subject.

provenance.attribution: Copyright Amazon.com Inc. or its affiliates; MASSIVE authors.

limits: Project taxonomy adaptation, not official MASSIVE 60-way accuracy.
220 cases were authored and labeled by the implementation agent, not independent human blind annotation.
Case content was designed with the existing product policy available; no evaluation labels or rationales enter model requests.
Initial class quotas and the audited test distribution do not reflect production prevalence; source samples cover only CHAT and RESEARCH.
No claim of full workflow execution quality, out-of-domain detection or adversarial security.
